theme: An open calendar, a full to-do list, and a trip that needs booking.
greeting: The calendar is clear today, Dan, but the fall trip won't book itself — a payment and a handful of reservations are the real work. The girls are with you in St. Pete, so it starts with breakfast.

needsAttention.title: Nautilus sailing balance
needsAttention.detail: Second reminder on the $6,475 course invoice (2170). The course starts Sept 12, so this window is closing now, not later.

needsAttention.title: Last Croatia night in Cavtat
needsAttention.detail: The single Sept 19 post-charter night and the Komolac-to-Cavtat transfer still aren't booked. Charter connectivity is poor, so it has to be locked before you fly out Sept 8.

needsAttention.title: Croatia checked bags
needsAttention.detail: The issued ticket shows zero checked bags on Eurowings Discover. Confirm the allowance on the operating carrier's own site and buy bags now if needed — counter rates run far higher.

needsAttention.title: St Pete landing-gap nights
needsAttention.detail: Sept 20-22 is the one lodging gap left in the Florida cycle: you land TPA the 20th, kids aren't picked up until the 22nd.

needsAttention.title: Disney tickets for six
needsAttention.detail: For the Sept 26-27 Orlando weekend, tickets are the piece with the hard wall now — check whether the ticket type needs park reservations.

schedule.title: Passport appointment, four girls
schedule.detail: Gateway Mall Post Office; new books, arrive 9:20, ~1 hour

flagged.title: Regulatory-affairs role at Resolution Life
flagged.detail: A LinkedIn alert flags a Head of Government and Regulatory Affairs opening — squarely in your lane.

flagged.title: Home policy renewal
flagged.detail: Liberty Mutual sent your home policy renewal notice; worth a look before it auto-renews.

flagged.title: Caregiver applicants on Care.com
flagged.detail: Three new applications came in to the job you posted, if you want to review the pool.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters and digests — Slifka, Midcoast Villager, a LinkedIn jobs roundup.

recipe.title: Composed summer salad with french feta
recipe.why: Peak-summer tomatoes and greens are at their best right now, so a composed salad lets them carry the plate.

tasks.title: Buy EU adapters + US power strip

acts.line: The 9:30 passport run for the girls anchors the morning, with a cluster of phone calls to make around it.
No meetings on the calendar — a clear stretch, and the Croatia bookings are what's waiting in it.
The girls are with you and Mike, so the day closes at home in St. Pete.
